additional_text: Adj Alajiʼ Pequeños Ant Riʼj var Chʼutiʼn, altuʼt

examples.example_maya: Ri alaj ikʼoy yalan jebʼel niyoʼöx chi rij (rikʼin) qʼutuʼn
